# sops_file (Resource)

Encrypt content with sops and write it to a file on disk. This is the counterpart to the sops_file data source. Encryption keys are resolved via the `.sops.yaml` creation rules found by searching destination_file's directory and its parents, no keys are configured on this resource directly. Provide the content to encrypt via `data_wo`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "sops" {}

# data_wo accepts any Terraform value directly, preserving real types instead of jsonencode/yamlencode
resource "sops_file" "demo-secret" {
  destination_file = "demo-secret.enc.yaml"
  data_wo = {
    password = "correct-horse-battery-staple"
    db = {
      password = "hunter2"
    }
    port    = 5432
    enabled = true
  }
  data_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `data_wo` (Dynamic, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The value to encrypt - an object, list, or scalar - marshalled according to output_type. Can be copied directly from any other Terraform value or resource attribute. Never stored in plan or state artifacts; must be used together with data_wo_version, since Terraform cannot detect changes to a write-only value on its own.
- `data_wo_version` (String) An arbitrary value that, when changed, tells Terraform that data_wo has changed and the resource should be updated.
- `destination_file` (String) Path to write the encrypted file to.

### Optional

- `output_type` (String) The provider will use the file extension of destination_file to determine how to format the content before encrypting it. If destination_file does not have the usual extension, set this argument to `yaml` or `json` accordingly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this resource, equal to destination_file.
